in_marathi.name: Suryanarayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suryanarayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who possesses the Sun. Suryanarayan is a combination of Surya, the Sun God, and Narayana, the God of the Universe and Preserver of the Cosmos. In Hindu mythology, Suryanarayan is revered as the deity of light, power, and wisdom.
